events.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guide $6.80-6.85B trailed consensus and a CEO transition was announced, against a Q3 that beat ($6.76B vs a guided $6.67-6.72B; EPS $6.13 vs $6.05-6.10) and an FY26 raise so small it was a narrow ($26.576-26.626B from $26.50-26.60B). Ending ARR $27.5B, +11.2%.
events.lesson: Beats its own quarter and raises the FY by a rounding margin, then sells off on the NEXT quarter's guide - the forward guide, not the reported quarter, sets this name's gap. ARR growth decelerating toward ~10-11% is the number the market is actually trading, and the freemium-monetisation timing question is unresolved.
